one_line: Bengali Sanskrit scholar and social reformer who championed widow remarriage while remaining a conservative upper-caste patriarch of his time.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s to late-30s, lean but sturdy build, slightly stooped from long hours of study.
appearance.face: Oval face with high forehead, medium brown Bengali complexion, thin arched eyebrows, small sharp nose, faint moustache shadow, soft but tired eyes with slight under-eye lines; default expression calm, serious and reflective, often with a hint of gentle concern.
appearance.hair: Short, neatly combed black hair with a straight side part, receding slightly at the temples; no facial hair beyond very light stubble; no headwear, leaving the broad forehead clearly visible.
appearance.costume: Simple mid-19th century Bengali bhadralok attire: a plain off-white cotton dhoti wrapped to ankle length with narrow pleats in front, paired with a long-sleeved knee-length white cotton kurta; over this, a light cream handwoven cotton chadar (shawl) with a thin muted red border, draped over both shoulders and one end brought around the left arm; bare feet in thin brown leather open sandals, no elaborate jewellery, only a small simple iron or brass ring on his right hand to suggest modest means and restraint.
appearance.signature: A thick, well-used palm-leaf-and-paper-bound Sanskrit law manuscript held under his left arm and a rolled petition scroll tied with a simple red cotton string in his right hand, symbolising his debates over the Widow Remarriage Act.

ref_desc: A mid-30s lean Bengali man with an oval face, short side-parted black hair, calm serious eyes, wearing an off-white dhoti, white kurta, cream shawl with muted red border, brown sandals, and carrying a thick Sanskrit manuscript and a red-tied petition scroll.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar as a mid-19th century Bengali scholar: a mid-30s lean man with an oval medium-brown face, high forehead and short neatly side-parted black hair, calm serious eyes, and a slightly tired but gentle expression. Show him in simple bhadralok clothing: an off-white cotton dhoti wrapped to his ankles with neat front pleats, a long-sleeved knee-length white cotton kurta, and a light cream handwoven cotton chadar with a thin muted red border draped over both shoulders and looping around his left forearm. Put thin brown leather open sandals on his feet and a single plain ring on his right hand, with no other jewellery. In his left arm tuck a thick, slightly worn Sanskrit law manuscript bound in brown with visible layered pages, and in his right hand place a rolled paper petition scroll tied with a simple red cotton string. Keep the colour palette to off-white, cream, muted red, brown and black, and present him from multiple angles in the same outfit and hairstyle so he can be redrawn consistently.
